timestamp_boundary: age >= 60 ms; elapsed >= 40 ms; integer physics ticks
transport: Capture and delivery use one simulation clock. Fresh packet every period; first sample at t=0.002s. replay-good keeps the last pre-fault capture tick, sequence and contacts but delivers again. silence delivers nothing. Both include the same forced opening as forced-open.
hypotheses: Three samples impose cadence-dependent waiting; elapsed duration reduces this coupling but remains quantized.
A fresh receipt of an old good observation can hide actual contact loss. Source-age checks should cancel both replay and silence.
scope: One deterministic rollout per matrix cell; 45 rollouts, no independent random trials. Privileged simulated contact, controlled actuator opening, no natural slip, clock skew, network jitter, vision, recovery or hardware safety validation.
